newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Gas rate filings will cut rates.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Gas rate filings will cut rates.

text.p: Equitable Gas Co said Thursday two planned rate filings, one an increase and the other a decrease, will result in an overall annual rate reduction of $12.4 million.

The first of two filings, to be submitted to the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission, calls for an increase in the company's annual revenues by $28 million attributable to a base rate increase, the Equitable Resources Inc subsidiary said, noting it is the first such increase requested by Equitable Gas since 1992.
The second filing, which will be made April 1, calls for a decrease in the company's annual revenues of $39.9 million, due to a reduction in purchased gas costs.

"A primary purpose of these filings is to realign our rates in order to promote competition and choice," the utility said. "These filings will decrease our customers' gas bills in a meaningful way and reverse the trend that has seen Equitable's rates rise to among the highest in the region."
As part of these proposed changes, Equitable said, it is seeking approval to allow all of its Pennsylvania customers to choose their own gas suppliers effective April 1, 1998.
